# Mermaid Rhapsody · unofficial fan site

> Unofficial, non-commercial fan site (semi-wiki + fan blog) for Tatsuki Fujimoto's one-shot
> 人魚ラプソディ (Mermaid Rhapsody, Jump SQ.19, 2014), part of the Fujimoto Archive network.
> Not affiliated with Tatsuki Fujimoto, Shueisha or the anime production.

The page is a single scroll "dive" in Indonesian and English: spoiler-free synopsis, characters
(Toshihide, Shiju), official clips (embedded, click to load), themes behind a spoiler filter,
gallery, release info, and links to the other Fujimoto Archive fan sites.

- Hub: https://dans-vsa.github.io/fujimoto-archive/
- Copyright: Mermaid Rhapsody © Tatsuki Fujimoto / Shueisha.
